translations.web: For godly sorrow produces repentance to salvation, which brings no regret. But the sorrow of the world produces death.
translations.bsb: Godly sorrow brings repentance that leads to salvation without regret, but worldly sorrow brings death.
translations.kjv: For godly sorrow worketh repentance to salvation not to be repented of: but the sorrow of the world worketh death.
translations.asv: For godly sorrow worketh repentance unto salvation, a repentance which bringeth no regret: but the sorrow of the world worketh death.
